findings.current: “Amitabha. E-excuse me, but might we pass through for a moment?”
findings.defect: The monk asks permission for himself to pass, but the draft changes the singular subject to “we,” implying that he represents a group.
findings.rationale: The scene identifies a single arriving monk, and the omitted Korean subject is resolved by his subsequent solitary movement through the swordsmen.
findings.replacement: “Amitabha. Excuse me, but may I pass through for a moment?”

findings.defect: The draft changes hearing about the place into physically visiting it, altering Jeok Cheongang’s stated experience.
findings.rationale: 들었지 is from 듣다, “to hear”; “to stop by” would take a form such as 들렀지.

findings.current: From what I had heard while traveling with him for half a day, he was naturally introverted. Once he lost control, however, he couldn’t rein himself in.
findings.defect: Dividing the statement into two independent traits omits the source’s causal link between his innately introverted nature and his inability to control himself once he snaps.
findings.rationale: The connective -이라 explicitly presents his introversion as the reason he becomes uncontrollable once pushed past his limit.
findings.replacement: From what I had heard during the half day we’d traveled together, he was so naturally introverted that once he snapped, he couldn’t control himself.
findings.source: 반나절 동안 함께 이동하며 들은 바로는, 타고난 성격이 내성적이라 한 번 눈이 돌아 버리면 주체를 할 수 없다고 했다.

findings.current: “…Hah. That shameless old bastard hasn’t changed. He can still see a thousand li while sitting on his ass.”
findings.defect: “Shameless” omits 신통한, which characterizes Hong Dao’s insight as uncanny or extraordinary, while “sitting on his ass” adds vulgarity not attached to 앉아서 in the source.
findings.rationale: 신통한 conveys extraordinary, almost supernatural perceptiveness; 땡중 supplies the disparaging register without making the neutral act of sitting vulgar.
findings.replacement: “…Hah. That damned monk is as uncanny as ever. He can still see a thousand li without leaving his seat.”
findings.source: “……허, 신통한 땡중 같으니. 앉아서 천 리를 내다보는 건 여전하군.”

findings.defect: The response no longer answers whether the technique is Shaolin martial arts and loses Jeok Cheongang’s comic qualification.
findings.rationale: 일단은 gives a reluctant, qualified affirmation: it is Shaolin martial arts, at least in the narrow sense.

findings.current:
Jeok Cheongang tilted his head several times before eventually nodding as though he more or less understood.

But I had a different opinion.
findings.defect: The draft adds that Jeok Cheongang understood the explanation, whereas the source only says that he gave a cursory nod.
findings.rationale: 대충 describes the casual or perfunctory manner of the nod, not Jeok Cheongang’s degree of understanding.
findings.replacement:
Jeok Cheongang tilted his head several times before giving a cursory nod.

But I had a different opinion.
findings.source: 적천강은 몇 차례 고개를 갸웃하더니 대충 고개를 끄덕였지만, 내 생각은 달랐다.

findings.defect: The em dash makes the mantra sound interrupted and omits the source’s exaggerated final yell.
findings.rationale: The extended 에에엑 turns the final syllable into a strained battle cry rather than cutting the utterance off.

findings.current: “Of course. It is a responsibility that a pampered Fire Gate Clan Leader like you could never know.”
findings.defect: The established title 문주 is rendered as “Clan Leader” instead of “Sect Leader,” and “pampered” changes 팔자 좋은 from having an easy or fortunate lot to being spoiled.
findings.rationale: The binding terminology requires “Sect Leader,” while 팔자 좋은 mocks Jeok Cheongang’s comparatively easy circumstances rather than asserting that he was pampered.
findings.replacement: “Of course. It’s a sense of responsibility that a carefree Fire Gate Sect Leader like you could never understand.”
findings.source: “아무렴. 팔자 좋은 열화문주 따위는 결코 느낄 수 없는 책임감이라네.”

findings.current: “Not yet. We have to climb halfway up Lesser Forest Peak. Visitors without a specific purpose are only allowed to remain at the Guest Reception Hall.”
findings.defect: “Lesser Forest Peak” is an invented literal-style name for 소실봉 rather than the established geographic name Shaoshi Peak.
findings.rationale: 소실봉 denotes Shaoshi Peak at Mount Song; “Lesser Forest” incorrectly imports the “forest” element of Shaolin.
findings.replacement: “Not yet. We have to climb halfway up Shaoshi Peak. Visitors without a specific purpose are only allowed to remain at the Guest Reception Hall.”
findings.source: “아직이다. 소실봉 중턱까지는 올라가야 하지. 별다른 목적 없이 온 방문객들은 지객당(知客堂)에만 머물러야 하고.”

findings.current: Jeok Cheongang dismounted and began climbing Lesser Forest Peak. After a moment, he spoke.
findings.defect: The second occurrence repeats the incorrect geographic name “Lesser Forest Peak.”
findings.rationale: The location is Shaoshi Peak, and its rendering must remain consistent across both occurrences.
findings.replacement: Jeok Cheongang dismounted and began climbing Shaoshi Peak. After a moment, he spoke.
findings.source: 말에서 내려 소실봉을 오르던 적천강이 문득 입을 열었다.

findings.defect: The draft makes the amount exactly four shichen and omits the source’s approximation.
findings.rationale: 한 before the quantity means “about” or “roughly,” qualifying the stated amount.
findings.replacement: “I can only sleep about four shichen.”

summary: Several subject, causal, register, quantity, and terminology errors require correction.
